stream: B_307 (cell 307 higher-order bottleneck + real order-3 research)
quarantine: No quantity is evaluated for CUSUM m=5 cells 305-309 or at any drift in [6/5, 13/5] or its mirror. Every fixture entry point calls ov_quarantine.guard_drift on its drift set; the lower-front script calls guard_cell on every (CUSUM, m, cell). Nothing below was chosen by similarity to cells 306-309.

FX_A_generic.what: generic sub-Markov drift families (exact rationals), generator b307_lib.generic_family
FX_A_generic.cell_half_width_rule: cover-rule analogue: rho = min(1/16, 1/(4*k1(e0)*C(e0))), then shrunk once to min(rho, 1/(4*k1_cell*C_cell)) with the certified cell bounds (the frozen K1 cover uses rho <= 1/(4 a C), a >= k1); plus the small-rho regime rho/16

FX_B_score_walk.what: one-sided discrete CUSUM-like walk on {0..N}: x -> max(0, x+z), z in {-1,0,+1}, alarm (killing) iff x+z > N; p_{+1}(e) = (1 + c e + d e^2 + c3 e^3)/3, p_{-1}(e) = (1 - c e + d e^2 - c3 e^3)/3, p_0 = (1 - 2 d e^2)/3; the e-derivatives of p sum to zero (score structure); atom = state 0 (reflection)

cells.rho_rule: same cover-rule analogue as FX_A, cap 1/8; plus rho/16

FX_B_score_walk.sources: S_0(x) = sum_z z p_z 1{alarm}; h_1(x) = sum_z p_z 1{alarm}; h_j = K h_{j-1}; S_r = J h_r with (J g)(x) = sum_z z p_z g(T(x,z)) 1{no alarm}; r = 0..4 (m = 5 assembly analogue)

candidates.K1_candidates: F^, D^, H^ = exact F, F', F'' at e0 plus deterministic seeded noise eta_K1 * U[-1,1] (eta_K1 = 1e-6)
candidates.real_order3_candidate: G^ = exact F''' at e0 plus seeded noise eta_G * U[-1,1] * max|F'''| (eta_G = 1e-3); a second variant eta_G = 1e-2

rules.time_grid: t = rho * k / 8, k = -8..8 (exact rationals) for pointwise soundness checks

LF_lower_front_historical.what: every committed file level4/closure_proofs/p5y_k5_lower_front_order3/evidence/tc_r1/cells/TC_CELL_*.json (34 files, cells 11-44) and the per-cell A0/A1/A2 and H_TC of TC_CONSUMPTION.json tc_audit, all r in 0..4, all m in {1,2,3,5}

GH_gaussian_identity.what: float identity check of the Hermite/likelihood-ratio form of the CUSUM kernel derivatives (K_i g)(x) = int g(T(x,z)) He_i(-(z+e)) phi(z+e) dz against the closed-form e-derivatives, for g = 1 and g = post-state coordinate
